basics.name: Alban NYANTUDRE
basics.summary: Machine Learning Engineer. Diplôme d'Ingénieur d'État in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence from the École Nationale des Sciences Appliquées (ENSA), Safi, July 2026. Deep learning for vision, language and speech, with speech and language technologies for low-resource African languages as the through-line. Looking for a PhD in deep learning, with an interest in multimodal learning.

work.summary: Quantum machine learning for drug discovery, in Moncton, Canada.
highlights: Literature review on quantum machine learning for drug discovery, covering molecular generative models and variational quantum circuits.
Collected and curated a dataset of 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX) inhibitors from chemical databases including ChEMBL, PubChem and BindingDB.
Implemented and evaluated hybrid quantum-classical generative architectures (QGAN, QVAE) and Transformers for the de novo generation of 5-LOX inhibitors.
Designed, trained and deployed translation, speech synthesis and speech recognition models (MT, ASR and TTS) for Mooré, a low-resource language with 7M+ speakers across 5+ West African countries.
Contributed to building one of the largest Mooré-language corpora to date, supporting low-resource NLP applications.
Developed and deployed ML models to predict prepayment risk on mortgage-backed securities, improving risk assessment for financial institutions.
